verdict.rationale: GoDaddy documents programmatic registration through its Domains API: a dedicated registration guide, a quote-token flow for register mutations, a 5-step end-to-end workflow with curl/Node/Python/Go samples, and a machine-readable v3 OpenAPI spec, plus PAT auth suited to scripts. Contacts are covered by WHOIS contact updates and the v1 contacts API. Nameserver configuration is only implied by truncated text on the DNS page, which mainly describes records on GoDaddy's own nameservers. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of setting contacts and custom nameservers within the registration call, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a scripted end-to-end registration.
